'''Erib Kurrugh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was one of the founders of the [[Sand Splitters]], a criminal organization on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], along with [[Saul Rouse]]. During this time, he operated out of the [[Sand Splitter Cave]] on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Sand Splitters infiltrated [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] and stole from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Saul Rouse and Erib Kurrugh were killed by Jabba's henchmen sent by [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]].<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erib Kurrugh appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Erib Kurrugh was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
